answer_1.quote: We study two standard compositional generalization benchmarks: the SCAN (Lake and Baroni, 2018) instruction following and COGS (Kim and Linzen, 2020, Fig. ) semantic parsing datasets. SCAN consists of simple instruction following tasks in which strings are translated into sequences of actions.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate sequences such as final states in instruction following (e.g., beaker configurations in ALCHEMY), logical forms in semantic parsing (COGS), and answers to visual questions (CLEVR).
